name: TODO scanner
description: Scans the open folder for TODO, FIXME, HACK and XXX comments (skipping node_modules, .git, dist and binary files), grouped by file with a filter box. Click a result to open it at that line.

tools.name: find_todos
tools.description: List TODO / FIXME / HACK / XXX comments in the project (file, line, text). Read-only.

path.description: Folder to scan (default: the whole project)
